description: AGE over a nullable operand is nullable -- the #163 gap: the existing date_age_interval fixture only used NOT NULL arguments, so it couldn't tell a sound implementation from an unsound one

columns.name: elapsed
columns.note: deleted_at is nullable, so AGE(NOW(), deleted_at) is nullable

name: age_nullable_operand
query_sql:
-- @name GetTimeSinceDeletion
-- @returns :many
SELECT AGE(NOW(), deleted_at) AS elapsed FROM accounts
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
